Name: GRASS_TYPE_PARAM_ST
Description: Scattered grass and small props (instanced models, flat tufts and billboards) generated on painted ground. A quality level (0–2) picks GrassTypeParam, GrassTypeParam_Lv1 or GrassTypeParam_Lv2; an ID missing from the chosen level falls back to the next lower level and finally to GrassTypeParam.

Fields.Name: LOD Range ID
Fields.Description: GrassLodRangeParam row giving the distances of the three LOD levels. Each LOD runs out to its range, then fades over its play distance. A missing row gives zero distances.

Fields.Name: LOD 0 - Cluster Type
Fields.Description: What is drawn at LOD 0 (nearest): none, model, billboard, flat tuft, simple model, or type 5. Retail: 1 (model) on almost every row.

Fields.Name: LOD 1 - Cluster Type
Fields.Description: What is drawn at LOD 1. Retail rows using type 5 almost always set Model Name [1]; rows using 4 set Simple Model Name; rows using 2 use the billboard texture.

Fields.Name: LOD 2 - Cluster Type
Fields.Description: What is drawn at LOD 2 (farthest). 0 draws nothing at this distance (retail: 0 on most rows).
Padding.

Fields.Name: Placement Method
Fields.Description: How instances are placed. 0: scattered at random, count set by Base Density. 1: on a regular grid set by Model Spacing, thinned by Dithering. Retail: 0 except one row.

Fields.Name: Base Density
Fields.Description: Random placement: instances per unit of ground area, multiplied by the painted grass weight of the triangle (fractional counts carry over to the next triangle). Grid placement: multiplies the painted weight that decides whether a grid point is filled. Retail: 0.05–10, mostly 1.

Fields.Name: Model Name [0]
Fields.Description: Main asset model (e.g. AEG001_254). Models of all GrassTypeParam rows are loaded up front.

Fields.Name: Flat Texture Name
Fields.Description: Texture of the flat-plane tuft (cluster type 3), e.g. AET005_004_a. Leave empty when unused.

Fields.Name: Billboard Texture Name
Fields.Description: Texture of the billboard (cluster type 2), e.g. AET005_004_a. Leave empty when unused.

Fields.Name: Slope Alignment %
Fields.Description: Percent (÷100) of how much each instance tilts to follow the ground's surface normal. 0 keeps it upright. Retail: 90 or 100 on most rows.

Fields.Name: Maximum Tilt Angle
Fields.Description: Degrees. The instance's final tilt from upright is capped at this angle. Retail: 30 on most rows, 0–180.

Fields.Name: Random Tilt
Fields.Description: Degrees. Random extra tilt of 0 up to this value on each horizontal axis. Retail: 0, 5 or 10.

Fields.Name: Width Scale - Min
Fields.Description: Percent. Each instance's horizontal size is picked at random between Width Scale - Min and Max (100 = model size).

Fields.Name: Width Scale - Max
Fields.Description: Percent. Upper bound of the random horizontal size (see Width Scale - Min).

Fields.Name: Height Scale - Min
Fields.Description: Percent. Each instance's height is picked at random between Height Scale - Min and Max, independently of the width.

Fields.Name: Height Scale - Max
Fields.Description: Percent. Upper bound of the random height (see Height Scale - Min).

Fields.Name: Color Shade [1] R
Fields.Description: Red of colour shade 1, as a 0–255 multiplier (255 = no tint).

Fields.Name: Color Shade [1] G
Fields.Description: Green of colour shade 1, as a 0–255 multiplier (255 = no tint).

Fields.Name: Color Shade [1] B
Fields.Description: Blue of colour shade 1, as a 0–255 multiplier (255 = no tint).

Fields.Name: Color Shade [2] R
Fields.Description: Red of colour shade 2, as a 0–255 multiplier (255 = no tint). Retail: 255 except two rows.

Fields.Name: Color Shade [2] G
Fields.Description: Green of colour shade 2, as a 0–255 multiplier (255 = no tint).

Fields.Name: Color Shade [2] B
Fields.Description: Blue of colour shade 2, as a 0–255 multiplier (255 = no tint).

Fields.Name: Plane Split Type
Fields.Description: Flat tuft: the planes are spread evenly over 180° (0, Half) or 360° (1, Full), so the angle between planes is 180° or 360° divided by Number of Planes.

Fields.Name: Number of Planes
Fields.Description: Flat tuft: number of planes, clamped to 1–8. Retail: 2 on most rows.

Fields.Name: Plane Angle
Fields.Description: Flat tuft: lean of the planes, in degrees (negative leans the other way). Retail: 0 except three rows (−30, 30, 5).

Fields.Name: Plane Distance
Fields.Description: Flat tuft: offset of the planes from the centre. Retail: 0, or 0.4 on the two flat-tuft rows.

Fields.Name: Cast Shadow
Fields.Description: 1 casts shadows, 0 doesn't. Retail: 0 on almost all grass, 1 on 9 rows.

Fields.Name: Wind Amplitude
Fields.Description: Wind sway strength. Baked into the model's vertices, scaled by each vertex's height within the model (base stays still), capped at 255. 0 disables the sway. Retail: 80, 0 on 7 rows.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Wind Speed
Fields.Description: Wind sway cycle, passed to the shader together with Wind Amplitude. Retail: 40, 0 where the amplitude is 0.

Fields.Name: Direction
Fields.Description: Degrees. Facing of each instance. Negative (−1) gives a random facing over the full 360°; otherwise the facing is picked between Direction − Direction Range and Direction + Direction Range.

Fields.Name: Direction Range
Fields.Description: Degrees either side of Direction that the facing may vary. Only used when Direction is 0 or more.

Fields.Name: Grid Spacing
Fields.Description: Grid placement only (Placement Method 1): distance between grid points; every other row is shifted by half a step. Retail: 0 except two rows (2 and 1).

Fields.Name: Grid Dithering
Fields.Description: Grid placement only: how the painted grass weight thins out the grid. 0: 8×8 ordered dither. 1: 4×4 ordered dither. 2: filled where the weight is at least 50%. 3: every grid point filled. Retail: 0.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Simple Model Name
Fields.Description: Low-detail asset model (cluster type 4). Leave empty when unused.

Fields.Name: Model Name [1]
Fields.Description: Second asset model. Retail rows that set this mostly use cluster type 5 for LOD 1 or 2.
